name: Slow Cooker Jerk Pork Bowls
intro_html: If your weeknight dinners have gotten a little boring, this Jamaican jerk pork wakes things right up. Lean pork loin slow cooks with onion and warm spice until tender, then goes over rice with broccoli. You get 56 grams of protein a serving for about $2.25 (at everyday cost), and it makes 14 bowls.
cost_note_html: Real Omaha store prices from our weekly grocery board (2026). They still swing by store and by what is on sale.
cost_lines: Rice, 5.25 cups dry: ~$1.17. Pantry staple; this batch alone uses about 2 2lb bags.
Pantry seasonings (jerk seasoning): ~$0.70. From jars you keep on hand.

Batch total: about $21.95 across 14 servings, so roughly $1.57 per bowl. This counts only the amounts this batch actually uses from each package, so it is the cost of the food in the containers, not a register receipt.

True shopping cost: about $25.15 across 14 servings, roughly $1.80 per bowl. What the register trip looks like if your pantry is already stocked. Meat, produce, and packaged items are counted as the whole packages you have to buy, since you cannot grab a partial box, can, or jar. Pantry staples you already own (rice, seasonings, oils, and long-lasting sauces) are counted at only what this batch uses.

Starting with an empty pantry? Add about $6.34 one time. That is the extra cost of buying full containers of every pantry staple in this recipe instead of just the amounts used, which puts a first shopping trip near $31.49. Those containers then feed this batch and many more after it.
cost_closing_html: About $2.25 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a high-protein dinner that beats takeout on price and macros.
shop_smart: Pork loin gives you jerk pork at diner prices. Buy the whole loin and portion it yourself for the best deal.
A jar of jerk seasoning lasts months and costs almost nothing per meal. Buy one good spice blend and lean on it again and again.
Frozen broccoli holds up great in the slow cooker rush. Stock the freezer with bags of florets so you always have a vegetable ready.
make_it: Cut the pork loin into large pieces and add them to the slow cooker.
Toss in the sliced onions and your jerk seasoning, rubbing it into the meat a bit, then pour in the broth.
Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours until the pork pulls apart easily.
Steam the broccoli florets just until tender toward the end.
Cook the rice so it is hot and ready.
Shred the pork, spoon it over the rice, and serve the broccoli alongside.
portion_html: Each of the 14 servings delivers 56 grams of protein and 597 calories, a genuinely filling bowl.
credit_html: Recipe adapted from Garlic & Zest, rebuilt for 14-serving budget meal prep with weighed portions and Omaha pricing.
upsell_html: A little heat, a little spice, and proof that cheap dinners never have to be dull. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons and tools, all for $1 a month.
